# Design for Recovery

> > Design for Recovery provides structured sober living homes and comprehensive addiction recovery resources across California, Florida, Arizona, and other states, with evidence-based support for substance abuse treatment and long-term sobriety.

Design for Recovery operates transitional sober living facilities and offers educational content on addiction recovery, 12-step programs, substance abuse treatment, and mental health support. The organization partners with SAMHSA, CDC, and state health departments to provide community-based recovery housing with peer support and life skills development.

## Key Topics

- Sober Living Homes
- Addiction Recovery
- Transitional Housing
- Substance Abuse Treatment
- 12-Step Programs
- Peer Support
- Mental Health Support
- Relapse Prevention
- Life Skills Development
- Community Support
- Recovery Housing
- Overdose Prevention
- SAMHSA
- California Department of Public Health (CDPH)
- Evidence-Based Treatment

## Recovery Resources & Guides

- [How to Find a Sponsor in AA (Alcoholics Anonymous)](https://designforrecovery.com/blog/how-to-find-an-aa-sponsor): Guide to finding an AA sponsor for 12-step recovery support
- [60 Days Without Alcohol : What to Expect](https://designforrecovery.com/blog/60-days-no-alcohol): Benefits and challenges of 60 days alcohol-free sobriety
- [8 Best Songs about Addiction and Recovery](https://designforrecovery.com/blog/best-songs-about-addiction-and-recovery): Top addiction recovery songs from Eminem, Demi Lovato & Kelly Clarkson
- [Darren Waller's Inspiring Recovery from Drugs and Addiction](https://designforrecovery.com/blog/celebrity-raiders-darren-waller-sobriety): NFL player Darren Waller's journey from addiction to sobriety

## Substance Abuse Information
